title: I. Growing Trees
statement:
You are given an undirected connected simple graph with n nodes and m edges, where edge i connects node u_i and v_i, with two positive parameters a_i and b_i attached to it. Additionally, you are also given an integer k.

A non-negative array x with size m is called a k-spanning-tree generator if it satisfies the following:

The cost of such array x is defined as ∑_{i = 1}^m a_i x_i^2 + b_i x_i. Find the minimum cost of a k-spanning-tree generator.

^dagger A spanning tree of a (multi)graph is a subset of the graph's edges that form a tree connecting all vertices of the graph.

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 500) — the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains three integers n, m, and k (2 ≤ n ≤ 50, n - 1 ≤ m ≤ min(50, (n(n - 1))/2), 1 ≤ k ≤ 10^7) — the number of nodes in the graph, the number of edges in the graph, and the parameter for the k-spanning-tree generator.

Each of the next m lines of each test case contains four integers u_i, v_i, a_i, and b_i (1 ≤ u_i, v_i ≤ n, u_i ≠ v_i, 1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ 1000) — the endpoints of the edge i and its two parameters. It is guaranteed that the graph is simple and connected.

It is guaranteed that the sum of n^2 and the sum of m^2 over all test cases does not exceed 2500.

For each test case, output a single integer: the minimum cost of a k-spanning-tree generator.

In the first test case, a valid 1-spanning-tree generator is x = [1, 1, 1, 1, 0], as indicated by the following figure. The cost of this generator is (1^2·5 + 1·5) + (1^2·5 + 1·7) + (1^2·6 + 1·2) + (1^2·3 + 1·5) + (0^2·4 + 0·9) = 38. It can be proven that no other generator has a lower cost.

In the second test case, a valid 3-spanning-tree generator is x = [2, 3, 2, 2, 3], as indicated by the following figure. The cost of this generator is (2^2·5 + 2·5) + (3^2·5 + 3·7) + (2^2·6 + 2·2) + (2^2·3 + 2·5) + (3^2·4 + 3·9) = 191. It can be proven that no other generator has a lower cost.

Input:
```
45 5 14 3 5 52 1 5 72 4 6 25 3 3 52 5 2 95 5 34 3 5 52 1 5 72 4 6 25 3 3 52 5 2 92 1 100000001 2 1000 100010 15 107 1 7 65 8 6 64 8 2 24 3 10 910 8 3 44 6 6 15 4 1 39 3 4 38 3 9 97 5 10 32 1 3 46 1 6 42 5 7 310 7 2 18 2 6 8
```

Output:
```
38
191
100000010000000000
2722
```
